features: ✨Acer Comfy Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo features Attractive, Ergonomic Durable Design with Nano Receiver. It is Compatible with both Microsoft Windows and Mac OS.

✨The keyboard is highly durable lifecycle of 10 million keystrokes for heavy usage of keyboard. Easy to connect USB connectivity for use with multiple operating systems.

✨Fast Scroll Wireless Mouse has 10 m Working Distance, has Swicth Life of 3 million clicks and Equipped with 2.4 GHz Frequency. It is highly durable design for the user comfort and navigation convenience. It features Plug and play connectivity with USB dongle.
